European football's governing body UEFA has given its "unanimous" backing to French Football Federation chief Philippe Diallo to stand against incumbent Gianni Infantino in March's FIFA presidential election, it said in a statement Monday. Under its Slovenian president Aleksander Ceferin, UEFA has led the opposition to Infantino since his announcement in late July of a project to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes speaks with Dr. Emanuel Macedo de Medeiros, Co-founder and Global CEO of the Sport Integrity Global Alliance.

item.title: New documentary explores history of crime and punishment in America
item.description:
A new four-episode PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America , debuts tonight and offers a deeply researched and engaging history of the country's efforts to create a fair and humane justice system. Written, directed, and produced by Lynn Novick and executive produced by Ken Burns, the documentary explores one of the most interesting but lesser-explored angles of our country's history. Like Reason 's recent cover story on the history of American prisons, the documentary recognizes that the question of what criminal punishment in a constitutional republic should look like has been, outside of the problem of race, perhaps the country's most consequential and enduring debate over the last 250 years.
